verdict.rationale: Superhuman explicitly documents 'Split Inbox' with custom categories like VIP, Notifications, Calendar, and Team, plus Auto Labels that classify incoming mail so users can triage by focus area rather than arrival order. This directly matches the story of prioritized, category-based triage streams. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of split-inbox usage in the wild (community evidence focuses on other features, not split inbox specifically).
